'''Jacek Namieśnik''' (10 December 1949 in Mogilno – 14 April 2019 in Gdańsk) was a Polish [[chemist]], full professor of [[Gdańsk University of Technology]]. He was head of Analytical Department (1995–2019), dean of [[Chemical Faculty, Gdańsk University of Technology|Chemical Faculty]] (1996–2002, 2005–2012),<ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.pg.gda.pl/informacje/historia/hist1.shtml| title = Profesor Jacek Namieśnik – uczony, nauczyciel i organizator (Professor Jacek Namieśnik - scientist, teacher and organizer)| access-date = 2016-04-05| author = Wacław Grzybkowski| website = Pg.gdas.pl| url-status = dead| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20071206040540/http://www.pg.gda.pl/informacje/historia/hist1.shtml| archive-date = 2007-12-06| author-link = Wacław Grzybkowski}}</ref> rector of Gdańsk University of Technology since 1 September 2016 until his death.<ref name="auto">{{cite web | url =http://pg.edu.pl/en/-/gdansk-university-of-technology-has-a-new-rector?redirect=http%3A%2F%2Fpg.edu.pl%2Fen%2Fnews%3Fp_p_auth%3DZ2OiSYlV%26p_p_id%3D101_INSTANCE_2OCHML5NTp6m%26p_p_lifecycle%3D0%26p_p_state%3Dnormal%26p_p_mode%3Dview%26p_p_col_id%3Dcolumn-1%26p_p_col_count%3D2 | title =Gdańsk University of Technology has a new rector | accessdate =2016-04-05 | website =pg.gda.pl | archive-date =2016-04-19 | archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20160419054321/http://pg.edu.pl/en/-/gdansk-university-of-technology-has-a-new-rector?redirect=http%3A%2F%2Fpg.edu.pl%2Fen%2Fnews%3Fp_p_auth%3DZ2OiSYlV%26p_p_id%3D101_INSTANCE_2OCHML5NTp6m%26p_p_lifecycle%3D0%26p_p_state%3Dnormal%26p_p_mode%3Dview%26p_p_col_id%3Dcolumn-1%26p_p_col_count%3D2 | url-status =dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web| url=https://pg.edu.pl/welcome-assets/-/asset_publisher/BLCJEe1FDMPc/content/we-bid-farewell-to-suddenly-deceased-professor-jacek-namiesnik?p_p_auth=f6ZMjUhC&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fpg.edu.pl%2Fwelcome-assets%3Fp_p_auth%3Df6ZMjUhC%26p_p_id%3D101_INSTANCE_BLCJEe1FDMPc%26p_p_lifecycle%3D0%26p_p_state%3Dnormal%26p_p_mode%3Dview%26p_p_col_id%3Dcolumn-1%26p_p_col_count%3D1 | title =We Bid Farewell to Suddenly Deceased Professor Jacek Namieśnik
 | accessdate =2019-04-14| website=pg.edu.pl }}</ref>

== Biography ==
In 1967 he graduated from the First High School in [[Inowrocław]] and started his studies at the Chemical Faculty of Gdańsk University of Technology. After graduating in 1972, he began his scientific career at this university, earning his degree in chemistry in 1978. The subject of his dissertation, conducted under the supervision of prof. [[Edmund Kozłowski]] was "The Determination of the total content of carbon and the content of organic carbon from volatile air pollutants". In 1985, on the basis of the dissertation "Concentration of volatile organic air pollutants", he obtained a degree of habilitated doctor, and the title of professor of chemical sciences received on 15 January 1996.

In 1990–1996 he was a Deputy Dean for Education of the Chemical Faculty of Gdańsk University of Technology, and in 1996–2002 and again 2005–2012 Dean of this Faculty. Beginning in 1995 he was also the head of the Department of Analytical Chemistry, which has been awarded the Center of Excellence.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://issuu.com/pg-gdansk/docs/pismopg-04052013/9|title=Pismo PG - 04-05.2013|website=Issuu.com|accessdate=16 November 2017}}</ref> Member of the Senate of the PG (since 1990) and head of the Doctoral Studies at the Chemical Faculty, Gdańsk University of Technology.

Elected to rector of Gdańsk University of Technology in 2016–2020<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pg.edu.pl/aktualnosci/-/asset_publisher/hWGncmoQv7K0/content/politechnika-gdanska-ma-nowego-rektora?p_p_auth=Ve8cH9SD&redirect=http://pg.edu.pl/aktualnosci?p_p_auth=Ve8cH9SD&p_p_id=101_INSTANCE_hWGncmoQv7K0&p_p_lifecycle=0&p_p_state=normal&p_p_mode=view&p_p_col_id=column-1&p_p_col_count=1|title=Politechnika Gdańska ma nowego rektora - Aktualności|website=Pg.edu.pl|accessdate=16 November 2017}}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

Simultaneously with the duties of the Rector of the Gdańsk University of Technology prof. Jacek Namieśnik held the function of Vice-President of the Conference of Rectors of Polish Technical Universities (KRPUT) from 2016 until his death in 2019.

==Teaching subjects==
* Analytical Chemistry

==Lecturer==
Jacek Namieśnik was the director of Doctoral Studies at the Chemical Faculty. The supervisor of 65 PhD thesis and 2 PhD thesis co-supervisor<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pg.edu.pl/documents/1789248/70454898/Wypromowani%20doktorzy_edycja%202019|title=Zestawienie pracowników PG, uwzględniające liczbę wypromowanych doktorów|last=|first=|date=|website=pg.edu.pl|access-date=2019-04-16}}</ref>

== Research interests ==
* Environmental Chemistry
* Analytical Chemistry
* Green Analytical Chemistry

== Awards ==
Jacek Namieśnik has won numerous awards for outstanding scientific achievements.
* 1993 – [[File:POL Złoty Krzyż Zasługi BAR.svg|60px|Ribbon]] [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Gold Cross of Merit]]
* 1995 – [[File:POL Medal KEN BAR.svg|60px]] [[Medal Komisji Edukacji Narodowej|Medal of the National Education Commission]]
* 1998 – [[File:POL Polonia Restituta Kawalerski BAR.svg|60px]] [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] - Knight's Cross
* 2005 – [[File:POL Polonia Restituta Oficerski BAR.svg|60px]] [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] - Officer's Cross
* 2016 – [[File:POL Polonia Restituta Komandorski BAR.svg|60px]] [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] - Commander's Cross
* 2017 – Prime Minister Award (individual)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://bip.kprm.gov.pl/kpr/bip-kancelarii-prezesa/nagrody-premiera/1983,Nagrody-Prezesa-Rady-Ministrow-za-dzialalnosc-naukowa-naukowo-techniczna-lub-art.html|title=Nagrody Prezesa Rady Ministrów za działalność naukową, naukowo-techniczną lub artystyczną - Nagrody Premiera - BIP Rady Ministrów i Kancelarii Prezesa Rady Ministrów|first=JSK|last=Internet|website=Bip.kprm.gov.pl|accessdate=16 November 2017}}</ref>
* 2019 – [[File:POL_Polonia_Restituta_Komandorski_ZG_BAR.svg|60px]] [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] - Commander's Cross with Star (post mortem)<ref>{{cite web|title=Oficjalna strona Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej / Aktualności / Ordery i odznaczenia / Krzyż Komandorski z Gwiazdą Orderu Odrodzenia Polski dla śp. prof. Jacka Namieśnika|url=https://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,404,krzyz-komandorski-z-gwiazda-orderu-odrodzenia-polski-dla-sp-prof-jacka-namiesnika.html|agency=www.prezydent.pl|accessdate=2019-04-17|archive-date=2019-04-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190417134929/https://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,404,krzyz-komandorski-z-gwiazda-orderu-odrodzenia-polski-dla-sp-prof-jacka-namiesnika.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He was also awarded by numerous bodies and councils governmental, regional and scientific. Since 2007 he has been Professor honoris causa of the University of Bucharest. He also has honoris causa doctorates from [[Gdańsk Medical University]] and the [[Military University of Technology in Warsaw]].<ref name="auto"/>

== Membership of societies ==
He was also very active outside of the home institution, as is evidenced by the large number of functions he performed in various academic and professional associations:<ref name="auto"/>
* [[Polish Chemical Society]] (Polskie Towarzystwo Chemiczne)
* Romanian Society of Analytical Chemistry
* [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] – IUPAC (fellow since 2000)
* Steering Committee International Society of Environmental Analytical Chemistry – ISEAC (since 2002)
* Polish Central Commission for Academic Degrees and Titles (2007-2016)
* Committee on Analytical Chemistry of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (PAS) since 1996, chairman of the Committee on Analytical Chemistry (2007-2015)
* Member of the Committee on Marine Research of the Polish Academy of Sciences (PAS) since 2007
* Member of Scientific Board Institute of Oceanology (PAS) since 2008
* Institute of Nuclear Chemistry and Technology (IChTiJ) since 2015
* [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]] (EASA) since 2017<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pg.edu.pl/aktualnosci/-/asset_publisher/hWGncmoQv7K0/content/prof-jacek-namiesnik-czlonkiem-europejskiej-akademii-nauk-i-sztuk-pieknych?p_p_auth=BySDff7c&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fpg.edu.pl%2Faktualnosci%3Fp_p_auth%3DBySDff7c&p_p_id=101_INSTANCE_hWGncmoQv7K0&p_p_lifecycle=0&p_p_state=normal&p_p_mode=view&p_p_col_id=column-1&p_p_col_count=1|title=Prof. Jacek Namieśnik członkiem Europejskiej Akademii Nauk i Sztuk Pięknych - Aktualności|website=pg.edu.pl|language=pl-PL|access-date=2017-12-13|archive-date=2017-12-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171213211329/https://pg.edu.pl/aktualnosci/-/asset_publisher/hWGncmoQv7K0/content/prof-jacek-namiesnik-czlonkiem-europejskiej-akademii-nauk-i-sztuk-pieknych?p_p_auth=BySDff7c&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fpg.edu.pl%2Faktualnosci%3Fp_p_auth%3DBySDff7c&p_p_id=101_INSTANCE_hWGncmoQv7K0&p_p_lifecycle=0&p_p_state=normal&p_p_mode=view&p_p_col_id=column-1&p_p_col_count=1|url-status=dead}}</ref>
